---
title: Top-level block
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
filters:
  - typst-extras
typst-extras:
  watermark: DRAFT
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        check: |-
          ! pdftotext "$EXTENSION_TEST_OUTPUT" - | grep -qF 'DRAFT' || { echo "the top-level block was applied"; exit 1; }
    typst:
      noErrors: true
      printsMessage:
        level: WARN
        regex: 'options: the top-level typst-extras block is ignored\. Move it under extensions: typst-extras:'
---
